# Minimal Demo App

## Problem

Developers need a simple reference implementation to test DeliveryOS end-to-end
before using it on a real project.

## Users

Primary: DeliveryOS contributors who want to smoke-test the full loop.

## Goals

- Provide a minimal but complete project that can be handed to a coding harness.
- Complete in under 10 minutes from raw idea to execution brief.

## Non-Goals

- Not intended for production use.
- Not a showcase of advanced DeliveryOS features.

## Risks

- **Scope creep** — even a demo app can grow. Mitigation: hard time-box of one session.

## Success Criteria

- The demo completes end-to-end in one session without manual intervention.
- All 7 CHUNK-06 done-when bullets are confirmed by the smoke walk.
